name: Roshutsu Kairaku 3 ~Chibu o Sarashite Modaete Nureru Ryouke Reijou, Shibaya Yayoi.
original_name: 露出快楽3～恥部を晒して悶えて濡れる良家令嬢、柴矢弥生。
source:
She was raised as a proper lady in a privileged home with high expectations.
Graceful and beautiful, demure, flawlessly courteous and kind...
Her future husband was already decided.
Truly, hers was the life of a perfectly bred specimen...
And it was suffocating.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax-touch/work/=/product_id/RJ076026.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
柴矢弥生出身优渥，自幼便承载着家族的殷切期望，被培养成一名举止得体的淑女。
她优雅美丽、端庄矜持，待人谦恭有礼又温柔亲切……
就连未来的丈夫也早已为她选定。
她的人生的确如同一件精心培育出的完美作品……
却也令她几乎窒息。

[内容取自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax-touch/work/=/product_id/RJ076026.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
